label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 138
title: Multi-modal I/O UI: upload/capture image/audio/video, preview/play generated media, manage assets
body: Dashboard UI for multi-modal: upload or capture (camera/mic) image/audio/video as agent input; preview/play generated image/video/audio outputs; asset manager (ids, links to artifacts/intake/backlog); per-modality progress. Consumes the backend multi-modal APIs.
